title: GEO Series Matrix Import
description: Preflight and import one bounded official GEO Series Matrix with sample metadata, structural QC, provenance, and explicit processed-value boundaries.

tools.name: geo_series_matrix_preflight
tools.description: Inspect the official matrix directory for one exact GSE accession, resolve one Series Matrix file, and report source size and local limits without downloading the matrix body.

matrix_file.description: Exact platform-specific matrix filename when the Series exposes more than one.

tools.name: geo_series_matrix_import
tools.description: Download and persist one researcher-approved official GEO Series Matrix under bounded compressed, decompressed, dimension and cell limits; preserve expression values, sample annotations, QC, source file and manifest.
